weld.rule: exact-attribute weld (bitwise-equal position / normal / uv), degenerate triangles and unreferenced vertices dropped: lossless

halfTurnFirst.rotation: a half turn about raw Y first: (x, y, z) -> (-x, y, -z)
halfTurnFirst.why: lead / lane AM: Meshy built the track shovel with its blade (the head) at raw +X

processing.lengthRule: uniform scale so the overall Z extent (muzzle / head to butt / pommel) = the plan's real length
processing.origin: the main hand (Grip) at the origin: the centred frame shifted by [-0.00224,-0.00281,0.56]

Grip.rule: x = the middle of a ray along X at y / z (the outermost surfaces: the local mid-plane); y = the middle of a ray along Y through the cross-section at z (the handle axis)

Grip2.rule: x = the middle of a ray along X at y / z (the outermost surfaces: the local mid-plane); y = the middle of a ray along Y through the cross-section at z (the handle axis)

Tip.rule: the front face: z = the minimum z; x / y = the centre of the vertices within 0.004 m of it

processing.markerNotes: two-handed: Grip = the rear hand near the handle end, Grip2 = the lead hand up the shaft; Tip = the blade point. The blade plate (~5.8 mm, kept: lead) lies in the Y-Z plane (its faces +-X)
